Fresh-root06 successfully generates a settings archive, uploads settings/content, receives and sends automatic saves, verifies exact witnesses and lists all three current cloud tiers. Its final payload checker fails because the case deliberately stopped essway before backup and never restarted it. The checker requires one real installed EmulationStation process and OS_NAME=pixelelated. Product hashes stayed unchanged. Retained allfour1/10seals and actual cleanup23:06:00/04.

Can this be done on the VM? Yes, an owned disposable guest/local WebDAV. Restore the fixture's ES lifecycle before final payload verification; do not remove the identity check or change product startup behavior.

Acceptance criteria:
- [x] Retain failed06 behavioral results, exact final failure, seals and cleanup; trace the explicit stop in fresh_roots and post-run process requirement.
- [x] Fresh sealed run passes all actual settings/content/automatic-save operations, restarts installed ES, verifies cloud bytes unchanged by that restart and passes the unchanged full payload/identity checks. All result channels/seals and actual cleanup are retained.

Already written: this is test lifecycle cleanup, not a product fix. #479 remains separately open for actual truncated-file retry failure. Refs #337, #478, #471.
